parameters.name: BackupId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup set.

parameters.name: CrossRole
parameters.description:
The RAM role name of the backup set owner's Alibaba Cloud account.

> Specify this parameter only when backing up across Alibaba Cloud accounts.

parameters.name: CrossUid
parameters.description:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the backup set owner.

> Specify this parameter only when backing up across Alibaba Cloud accounts.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster.

> Call [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) to list cluster IDs in a region.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. It must be later than the start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Valid values: positive integers greater than 0 and no larger than the maximum value of the integer data type. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

- **30** (default)

- **50**

- **100**

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

> Call [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) to list supported regions and zones for AnalyticDB for MySQL, including region IDs.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ.
